title: Oaklight Path

checkpoint.description: The mossy trail marker at the lower fork

accessibilityNotes: Every action is turn-based; use arrow keys, WASD, or the on-screen direction buttons. No timing or audio cue is required.

title: Twin Spring Switches

checkpoint.description: The stone just beyond the entry bend

accessibilityNotes: Switches are marked with T and activate with the same Interact action; the route uses no timer or color-only signal.

title: Prism Fork

checkpoint.description: The safe ledge below the fork

accessibilityNotes: The two routes are shown as distinct corridors in the map; no hidden platform or audio-only information is used.

title: Resonant Gate

checkpoint.description: The carved alcove before the lower switch

accessibilityNotes: Both switches can be approached without a timer; the gate opens after both are activated and is represented with a distinct G symbol.

title: Tidepool Errand
accessibilityNotes: Water is decorative in this level; the traversable route is unambiguous and all movement is discrete.

title: Beacon Causeway
accessibilityNotes: No real-time countdown is used; each beacon switch is activated on demand with Interact.

title: Foundry Key

checkpoint.description: The marked safe tile at the workshop entrance

accessibilityNotes: Hazard H returns the player to the visible R checkpoint without losing progress; the turn-based hazard needs no reaction speed.

title: Gearhouse Circuit

checkpoint.description: The floor plate beside the entrance

accessibilityNotes: The gearhouse is turn-based rather than timed; the gate remains visible and opens after the two T switches.

title: Windward Seeds
accessibilityNotes: The wind is visual only; no reflexes or sound cues are needed, and the alternate path is fully traversable.

title: Terrace Pair
accessibilityNotes: Two players can use separate input devices; both plate positions are stated in the objective and no synchronized timing window is imposed.

title: Ashen Archive
accessibilityNotes: Heat is represented by scenery, not a hazard; players can choose either clear corridor without time pressure.

title: Cooling Valves

checkpoint.description: The safe tile at the valve room entrance

accessibilityNotes: Valve order is unrestricted, activation is manual, and every route uses the same non-timed controls.

title: Quiet Stacks
accessibilityNotes: The maze layout is fully visible, has no moving walls, and does not rely on sound, color, or time.

title: Index of Two
accessibilityNotes: Both players can reach their marked switch without a countdown; the route and goal are described in text.

title: Mirage Marker
accessibilityNotes: Mirages do not hide or change tiles; the collectible and exit are visible and reachable by a non-timed detour.

title: Oasis Locks
accessibilityNotes: No heat timer is present; gate, switches, and safe route use distinct symbols and keyboard-accessible interaction.

title: Warm Lantern
accessibilityNotes: Snow effects are decorative; the grid is static and can be navigated with keyboard or equivalent buttons.

title: Aurora Relay
accessibilityNotes: The aurora is not needed to solve the level; each player can move independently, and plates have no timing requirement.

title: Orbiting Petal
accessibilityNotes: The orbital motif is cosmetic only; all paths are static, visible, and navigated one tile at a time.

title: Constellation Chorus
accessibilityNotes: Two participants activate separate marked stations; there is no timer, required voice chat, color cue, or audio cue.
